_about: Rules from a degree's programme page or regulations that the scraped data flattens. Applied by scripts/slots-from-regulations.mjs: 'either' entries attach to the converted slot whose text starts with the paper label; 'fill' entries (used with --fill) give an existing slot the course list and unit amount of a regulations paper.
